observation.command: echo "=== manager-api direct 18082 ==="; for url in "http://localhost:18082/xplan-manager-api/" "http://localhost:18082/xplan-manager-api/swagger-ui.html" "http://localhost:18082/xplan-manager-api/v3/api-docs" "http://localhost:18082/"; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -m 30 "$url"); echo "$code  $url"; done; echo "=== via apache 8080 ==="; for url in "http://localhost:8080/xplan-manager-api/" "http://localhost:8080/xplan-manager-api/index.html"; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -m 30 "$url"); echo "$code  $url"; done; echo "=== manager-api webapp dir ==="; ls /opt/tomcat-api/webapps/xplan-manager-api/ 2>/dev/null | head -30
